technical.summary: IWM shows strong short-term bullish technicals but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 95.61, stoch 94.44) with bearish stoch cross and price below 200SMA create significant reversal risk; entry quality compromised by lack of triggered strategy and sector headwind.

fundamental.summary: IWM shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; neutral fear/greed, no recent congressional buying, stale sales data (112+ days old), and unavailable news sentiment provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (353.12) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event in 2 days adds binary risk; small caps particularly vulnerable to risk-off sentiment and credit tightening.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 95.61 extreme overbought with supertrend bullish and price above EMA 9/21/50 suggests short-term momentum continuation if support at 179.26 holds.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels 353.12, CPI event in 2 days), price below 200SMA, stochastic bearish cross, zero fundamental conviction, and small-cap vulnerability to risk-off sentiment create unacceptable reversal risk.
